unit.assessment: Domain rejection and repository side effects

e2e.assessment: Separate CLI process and public persisted account listing

criteria.assessment: Exact rejection and absence of account creation are asserted at domain and CLI seams.

tests.assertion_assessment: Asserts rejection reason and absence of repository creation.
tests.counterexample: Returning expired after creating an account would fail the no-create assertion.
tests.tdd_continuity_assessment: The red and green case retain both behavior assertions.

tests.assertion_assessment: Uses a separate process and checks persisted state through public commands.
tests.counterexample: CLI ignores domain rejection and persists an account; response or account listing assertion fails.
tests.tdd_continuity_assessment: The same externally observable contract is asserted in red and green.
